text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. The aura 
radiating from Symboli Rudolf was 
completely different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A ferocious, intimidating presence that 
brings back memories of days gone by— 
Feeling a twinge of nostalgia, Sirius 
Symboli glares at her back, eyes burning 
with intensity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just who is the stronger of the two? A 
grand showdown to settle the score once 
and for all was about to begin.
